description: What breaks in THIS project's tasks if one collection moves to an exact version: removed or moved modules (meta/runtime.yml redirects and tombstones), removed options and aliases, newly required options, dropped choices, type and default changes, each tied to the task's file:line, plus requirements.yml constraints and a verdict. Downloads the target collection from Galaxy (or the configured servers) into this server's cache on first use; never touches dir, requirements files or your collections paths.

dir.description: Ansible project directory. Default: ANSIBLE_MCP_DIR, else the server's working directory.

include_unused.description: Also list removed/moved/deprecated content of the collection this project does not use (capped at 200)

syntax_check.description: Confirm with ansible-playbook --syntax-check against the target

version.description: Exact target version, e.g. 12.0.0 (not a constraint)

name: ansible_upgrade_impact
title: Collection upgrade impact
